description.narrative: THE PROJECT WOULD INCLUDE THREE SUBPROGRAMS: (A) QUALITY IMPROVEMENT OF SECONDARY EDUCATION, (B) MODERNIZATION OF TECHNICAL-PROFESSIONAL EDUCATION (POST-SEC.) AND (C) STRENGTHENING OF MANAGEMENT AND ADMINISTRATION OF THE SECONDARY EDUCATION SYSTEM. ACTIVITIES TO BE SUPPORTED INCLUDE: DEVELOPMENT OF TECHNICAL-PEDAGOGICAL MATERIALS, REHABILITATION OF PHYSICAL INFRASTRUCTURE, INCLUDING EQUIPMENTMATERIALS, AND HUMAN RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT, PARTICULARLY SECONDARY SCHOOL TEACHERS.
